report.summary: Cross-file analysis reveals missing consumers for written artifacts, dead UNWIRED symbols, and potentially overstated claims lacking supporting dependency edges or symbols.
risks: daedalus/mapping/render.py writes docs/architecture-map.html but no module reads it (missing edge).
Multiple UNWIRED symbols in daedalus/mapping/render.py (esc, _slug, _inline, _md_blocks, _render_md, NarrativeSection, Narrative) are dead code.
daedalus/loop.py claims to respect governance from daedalus.core.get_governance() but daedalus.core is not a dependency (overstated claim).
daedalus/spine/containment.py makes strong WRITE containment claims but has a missing JobLimits (SMELL) and no test symbols provided to verify.
daedalus/spine/containment.py writes low-integrity log files with no evident consumer (missing edge).
todos: Audit UNWIRED symbols in render.py to decide removal or wiring.
Verify if architecture-map.html is consumed by any external process; if not, consider deprecation.
Check daedalus/loop.py for actual governance dependency or update claim.
Review containment claims in spine/containment.py against test suite; resolve missing JobLimits.
Ensure containment logs are read or monitored; otherwise, reduce log generation.
Run a full project-wide empirical dependency scan to complement the census.

handoff.suggestion: Combine with other shards to verify missing edges. Use static analysis to map actual import/dependency graph. Prioritize fixing UNWIRED symbols to reduce dead code.
